candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement that resets the sender's credit to zero before the external call.
Move the external call before the balance update and credit reset, enabling reentrancy to observe stale state.
Delete the require check on the external call result so failed transfers still reset credit and reduce balance.
Remove the statement that zeroes the caller's credit before the external call, so credit is not cleared on withdrawal.
Move the credit zeroing statement to after the external call, enabling reentrancy to withdraw multiple times.
Change balance decrement to increment, so contract balance accounting goes the wrong way.
Remove the require(callResult) check so failed transfers are silently ignored while credit is still zeroed.
Remove the balance decrement so the internal balance no longer tracks withdrawals.
